parts: Big-Foot de Thalek Look At Me
Male red and white born on 27 of October of 2011.
DNA-identified at the Société Centrale Canine. Confirmed in France.
From the cross of our latest import, Feel The Angel (Dandy), with our female Clear Spring (Yazmine), daughter of our Champion Amistad Sincera (Miss), this beautiful dog was born.

He is living with our dear friends Stéphanie Duronssoy, Jérome Gaschet and their Shih Tzu in France. We thank them for their trust in us, our dogs and our breeding methods, and for acquiring Jimmy to show him in Europe.
We hope and wish that his show career will be successful and that we will soon hear news of him at shows, and above all that he will be very, very happy with his new parents.
